about.intro: A public, read-only collection of anime quotes, available in a browser and through a versioned API.
about.feature_random: Get a random quote or browse the complete embedded collection.
about.feature_search: Search quote text, anime titles, and character names.
about.feature_apis: Use the REST API, read-only GraphQL API, or anime-cli.
about.feature_browser: Use the browser interface on desktop and mobile.
about.rights_notice: Quote text remains the property of its respective rights holders. This project distributes the curated collection as a public reference.

help.title: Help
help.intro: Browse the quote collection or use the read-only API and command-line client.
help.browse_description: Search by quote text, anime, or character.
help.api_search: Search quotes. The {q}, {anime}, and {character} parameters are optional and can be combined:
help.api_response: Responses use a JSON success envelope. The quote fields are {anime}, {character}, and {quote}.
help.tor_available: This service is also available at {address} through the Tor network.
help.faq_account_question: Do I need an account or API key?
help.faq_account_answer: No. The read-only browser and API routes are public.
help.faq_submit_question: Can I submit or edit quotes?
help.faq_submit_answer: No. The collection is embedded in the server binary and has no write API.
help.faq_limit_question: Why did I receive a rate limit response?
help.faq_limit_answer: Requests are rate limited to protect service availability. Wait briefly before retrying.
help.no_pages: No additional help pages are enabled.

mcp_page.title: MCP server
mcp_page.lead: Connect an AI assistant to the Anime Quotes API.
mcp_page.overview: Anime Quotes provides read-only quote and service operations through remote Streamable HTTP. Every MCP request requires a Bearer token.
mcp_page.authentication: Every MCP request requires the same Authorization: Bearer token used by the REST API. Use a dedicated linked owner token for this client, never the operator token. Public REST reads remain available without a token.
mcp_page.tools_content: The live tool list below is also returned by tools/list. Authenticated APIs may expose additional tools.
mcp_page.tool_note: Tools use the same limits and permissions as the corresponding public API routes.
mcp_page.limits: POST only; no sessions; the same rate limits as the API. Browser Origin values must match this origin or the configured public FQDN. Supported protocol version: {version}.
mcp_page.troubleshooting: 400: use the supported protocol version and matching MCP headers. 401: provide a valid API Bearer token. 403: use an allowed Origin. 405: send POST requests only.
mcp_page.project_content: Use getRandomQuote for one quote. Use listQuotes with optional q, anime, or character filters to search. getHealth reports service health and getStats reports collection statistics. The collection is read-only; no create, update, or delete tools are available.
mcp_page.status_400_meaning: Invalid request, protocol version, or MCP header.
mcp_page.status_400_fix: Use MCP revision {version} and match request headers to the JSON-RPC body.
mcp_page.status_401_meaning: A protected operation needs a valid Bearer token.
mcp_page.status_401_fix: Send the same Authorization: Bearer credential used with the REST API.
mcp_page.status_403_meaning: The Origin is not allowed or the operation is not permitted.
mcp_page.status_403_fix: Use the service origin or a configured public origin.
mcp_page.status_405_meaning: The endpoint received a method other than POST.
mcp_page.status_405_fix: Send JSON-RPC requests with HTTP POST.
